title: Logistic Classif
comment: Logistic Classif — Logistic regression defines fuzzy classification boundaries using the softmax operator. At the heart of many supervised learning classification approaches. Introduced by David Cox in 1956. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Logistic_regression
alt_text: Logistic Classif. Logistic regression defines fuzzy classification boundaries using the softmax operator. At the heart of many supervised learning classification approaches. Introduced by David Cox in 1956.

title: Stam Fluid
comment: Stam Fluid — Classic reference: Jos Stam, Stable fluids, 1999. One of the most influential papers in PDEs for graphics. Made computational fluid dynamics accessible to (almost) anyone. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos_Stam
alt_text: Stam Fluid. Classic reference: Jos Stam, Stable fluids, 1999. One of the most influential papers in PDEs for graphics. Made computational fluid dynamics accessible to (almost) anyone.

title: Logdet
comment: Logdet — The determinant is a log-concave function. Determining the Loewner enclosing ellipsoid with minimum volume can be solved using a convex optimization problem under semi-definite constraints. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_ellipsoid
alt_text: Logdet. The determinant is a log-concave function. Determining the Loewner enclosing ellipsoid with minimum volume can be solved using a convex optimization problem under semi-definite constraints.

title: Tutte
comment: Tutte — Classic reference: William Thomas Tutte, How to draw a graph, 1963. Shows how to embed a planar graph in 2-D by solving a Laplacian linear system. Heavily used in mesh processing to compute surface parameterization. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tutte_embedding
alt_text: Tutte. Classic reference: William Thomas Tutte, How to draw a graph, 1963. Shows how to embed a planar graph in 2-D by solving a Laplacian linear system. Heavily used in mesh processing to compute surface parameterization.

title: Marching Cubes
comment: Marching Cubes — Marching Cubes is the standard algorithm to extract an isosurface from a voxelized volume. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marching_cubes
alt_text: Marching Cubes. Marching Cubes is the standard algorithm to extract an isosurface from a voxelized volume.

title: Viscosity Solutions
comment: Viscosity Solutions — Classic reference: M Crandall, P-L Lions, Viscosity solutions of Hamilton-Jacobi equations, 1983. Defines a notion of weak solution for a class of first-order PDEs including the Eikonal equation to compute geodesic distances. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity_solution

title: Cucker Smale
comment: Cucker Smale — The Cucker-Smale system of ODEs is the simplest model of particles exhibiting flocking behaviors. Diffusion of speeds is governed by a Laplacian on the fully connected graph of points. https://mantiq.fr/img/cucker06.pdf
alt_text: Cucker Smale. The Cucker-Smale system of ODEs is the simplest model of particles exhibiting flocking behaviors. Diffusion of speeds is governed by a Laplacian on the fully connected graph of points.

title: Lasso
comment: Lasso — Classic reference: Tibshirani, Robert, Regression Shrinkage and Selection via the lasso, 1996. Introduces l1 regularization as a method for high-dimensional regression. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lasso_(statistics

title: Sketching
comment: Sketching — Kernel methods can be accelerated using random projections to perform a low-rank approximation of the kernel. For translation-invariant kernels, one can use Fourier projections.

title: Beckmann
comment: Beckmann — Classic reference: M. J. Beckmann, A continuous model of transportation, 1952. Introduces a linear program model for congestion which is a dual formulation of W1 optimal transport. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum-cost_flow_problem
alt_text: Beckmann. Classic reference: M. J. Beckmann, A continuous model of transportation, 1952. Introduces a linear program model for congestion which is a dual formulation of W1 optimal transport.

title: Laplacian Eigenmaps
comment: Laplacian Eigenmaps — Laplacian eigenmaps perform non-linear dimensionality reduction ("manifold learning") by embedding data points using the eigenvectors of a graph Laplacian as coordinates. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nonlinear_dimensionality_reduction
alt_text: Laplacian Eigenmaps. Laplacian eigenmaps perform non-linear dimensionality reduction ("manifold learning") by embedding data points using the eigenvectors of a graph Laplacian as coordinates.

title: Nelder Mead

title: Sne
comment: Sne — Classic reference: S. Roweis, G. Hinton, Stochastic neighbor embedding, 2002. SNE performs dimensionality reduction by minimizing relative entropy (KL) between high and low dimensional spaces. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-distributed_stochastic_neighbor_embedding

title: Alpha Shapes
